{{Quote|You'll wish you had been more cooperative.|Harfard, to acting Grand Master Kenth Hamner|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
'''Oric Harfard''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in [[Galactic Alliance Security]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. He led the Security forces that were sent to the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] to arrest the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]], who had recently gone on a destructive rampage as the result of a [[Force psychosis|psychotic breakdown]]. Harfard later led the Security forces to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Temple in search of the rogue Jedi [[Seff Hellin]], who had been secretly [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|captured]] by [[Darkmeld]]&mdash;a covert organization formed by Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] to counter the [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi]] policies&mdash;and brought to the Temple to be studied. When Harfard questioned acting [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]], Hamner denied knowledge of Hellin's whereabouts, as Solo had kept her organization secret from the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]].

Captain Harfard [[44 ABY|later]] accompanied Daala when she met with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], Jaina's [[Parent/Legends|father]], during the [[Siege of the New Jedi Temple|siege]] of the Jedi Temple in order to negotiate the surrender of psychotic Knights [[Sothais Saar]] and [[Turi Altamik]] to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. The move was a ploy orchestrated by the Jedi, however, as Saar and Altamik had both been cured. Once this had been proved to Daala, she was forced to order Harfard to lift the siege on the Temple.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You have failed to identify yourself.''"<br />"''Captain Oric Harfard, Galactic Alliance Security. Now get out of my way, fish-head.|Master Cilghal and Oric Harfard|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
[[File:Natasi_Daala.jpg|thumb|left|190px|Natasi Daala (pictured) issued Harfard a warrant for Valin Horn's arrest.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Oric Harfard was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in [[Galactic Alliance Security]].<ref name="Outcast" /> In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="Forums">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM|quote=with FotJ starting at 43.5.}}</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Valin Horn]] suffered a [[Force psychosis|psychotic breakdown]] that caused him to go on a destructive rampage. He was quickly caught and placed in the [[Mon Mothma Memorial Medical Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and then transferred to the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]], also located on the planet. Harfard was later issued a warrant by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]], for the arrest of Horn. Harfard led a group of Security troopers, along with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jesmin Tainer|Zilaash Kuh]] and [[Vrannin Vaxx]], to take custody of Horn. He was stopped outside the Temple entrance, where he had a dispute concerning the authorization of his entrance with the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyp Durron]]. Master [[Cilghal]] quickly arrived at the scene and defused the situation, reluctantly allowing Harfard to enter. During the arrest, Cilghal proceeded to delay the captain, but Harfard eventually took Horn into custody. Horn was then put on [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|trial]], encased in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], and placed in the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]], a Galactic Alliance [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="Outcast" />

[[File:KenthHamner-Vortex.jpg|thumb|right|190px|Harfard questioned Kenth Hammer, who was unaware of Hellin's whereabouts, frustrating the former.]]
Shortly thereafter, Jedi Knight [[Seff Hellin]], who was suffering from the same disease as Horn, attempted to rescue the carbonite-encased Jedi from the prison. During his [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|rescue attempt]], Hellin was captured by [[Darkmeld]], a covert organization formed by Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] to counter Daala's increasingly [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi]] policies. During Hellin's capture, Solo was spotted with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and, although she was not recognized, the sighting led the Galactic Alliance to believe that a Jedi had captured Hellin. The next day, Harfard&mdash;who had recently been made point man for Alliance-[[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] interactions&mdash;was issued a warrant for the arrest of Hellin. Harfard once again led a force of Security troopers to the Jedi Temple. There, he questioned the acting [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]], who truthfully denied all knowledge of Hellin's whereabouts, since Solo had kept Darkmeld's operations secret from the Jedi Masters. The captain quickly became exasperated, and after exchanging threats with Hamner, Harfard and the Security troops left the Temple.<ref name="Outcast" />

Later, in [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> Harfard accompanied Daala when she arrived at the Jedi Temple to negotiate the public surrender of psychotic Jedi Knights [[Sothais Saar]] and [[Turi Altamik]] during the [[Siege of the New Jedi Temple|siege]] of the Temple. Harfard frisked [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], Jaina's [[Parent/Legends|father]], who came out to greet Daala, for weapons. However, the move was a ploy by the Jedi&mdash;they used that moment to show that the formerly psychotic Knights had actually been cured. Solo told Harfard to order the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] who were sieging the Temple at Daala's orders to hold their fire, as Saar and Altamik were coming out of the Temple. As the Jedi emerged, Harfard ordered some of his troops to quickly form a guard around Daala. When Solo suggested that the Chief of State was scared, she ordered Harfard to have his men stand down, and he obliged very reluctantly. As Saar and Altamik approached, Harfard held Solo at blasterpoint and refused to let the Jedi come near Daala. Solo, however retorted that assassination was not in the Jedi character, and Daala waved Harfard aside. After [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Thalleus Tharn]] observed Saar and Altamik and pronounced them cured, Daala ordered Harfard to lift the siege.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|By the way, where is Captain Savar? The intelligent one who stands a chance of promotion sometime in his career?''"<br />"''Out cuddling Ewoks, I expect.|Cilghal and Harfard|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
Harfard was a lanky man<ref name="Vortex" /> who believed himself to be superior to others and enjoyed being in control of situations. As such, he was often quick to anger when those beings around him did not follow his orders. This led him to assume a dislike for the Jedi, who frequently defied him. Harfard was often condescending to those that irritated him, and he openly slandered fellow Security Captain [[Savar]]. He also insulted Cilghal by calling her a "fish-head"&mdash;a derogatory name for her [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. Harfard also frequently threatened beings that annoyed him or got in his way.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Done with my warrant card yet?|Harfard to Cilghal|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
As a member of Galactic Alliance Security, Harfard wore the standard blue [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and helmet, and carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="Vortex" /> When he arrived at the Jedi Temple with several security troopers to take Valin Horn into custody, Harfard presented Cilghal with a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] containing his warrant and an [[Identichip/Legends|identicard]] to verify his identity.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oric Harfard first appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', a novel written by [[Aaron Allston]] as the first installment in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series that was released in [[2009]].<ref name="Outcast" />
